name: Wanted Dead or a Wild

features.name: VS symbols
features.description: In the base game and Duel at Dawn bonus, VS symbols expand into a full-reel wild with a multiplier up to 100x.

features.name: Great Train Robbery
features.description: Free spins with sticky multiplier wilds.

features.name: Dead Man's Hand
features.description: Sticky wilds where multipliers reset each spin, combined with Duel at Dawn.

review:
The game that made Hacksaw famous with high-volatility players. Three different bonuses – Duel at Dawn, Great Train Robbery and Dead Man's Hand – give it far more variety than a single free spins round.

The Duel at Dawn feature, with expanding VS reels and multipliers, can produce huge results in just a few spins, which is why streamers love it. Be warned: it's very swingy – most bonuses pay modestly and a few pay enormously. High volatility, 12,500x max, 96.38% RTP.
author: editorial-team
